context-description: Socioeconomic indicators are used to assess how feasible each climate action is for this city. Indicators such as income levels, employment, and urban density shape which actions are realistically deliverable.
feasibility-note: Mitigation feasibility shapes 33% of the feasibility score · Feasibility shapes 23% of the ranking
ranking-weight: Socioeconomic context shapes 33% of the feasibility score · feasibility shapes 23% of the ranking
indicators-error-body: We couldn't reach the indicator service for this city. Check your connection and try again.
no-indicators-description: There are no socioeconomic indicators available for this city yet. Coverage in the Global API is still sparse, and this city has not been profiled.
no-indicators-continue: You can still continue to the next step — the ranking will be generated without socioeconomic context.
